messages.content: Can you help me Get object descriptors related to a domain example.org on VirusTotal? The relationship I want to check is subdomains. You should just return the related object's IDs (and context attributes, if any) instead of returning all attributes. My key is my_api. Set the limit to 10 and the continuation cursor to abc.

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
Here’s a concise representation of the sub‑domain relationships you requested.  
Only the identifiers and any available context attributes are shown; no other metadata is returned.

```json
{
  "related_objects": [
    { "id": "sub1.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub2.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub3.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub4.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub5.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub6.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub7.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub8.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub9.example.org" },
    { "id": "sub10.example.org" }
  ],
  "continuation_cursor": "def"
}
```

**How to retrieve this data from VirusTotal**

```bash
curl -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/example.org/relationships/subdomains?limit=10&cursor=abc" \
     -H "x-apikey: my_api"
```

Replace `my_api` with your actual API key. The response will contain the same structure as above, with up to 10 sub‑domains per page and a new cursor (`def`) for the next batch.
